pages.title: Day 11: Stayin' Alive
pages.text: Stayin' Alive is Day 11 of Vectorman (BlueSky Software, 1995), the last of its three boss stages seen from above. VGMPF lists the tune at 2 minutes 29 seconds.

pages.title: Racing the clock
pages.text: Every stage of Vectorman has a timer, and Vectorman loses a life if it runs out, says Sega Retro. Electronic Gaming Monthly reminded players in 1995 that "the clock is always ticking".
